title: Cotton Stamps, Budget, & Building Safety
summary:
*   Approved participation in the federal Cotton Stamp Plan, a program for distributing surplus commodities and cotton goods to residents.
*   Established detailed safety regulations for a building construction site, including requirements for protected pedestrian walkways, barricades, and a $5,000 bond for public safety.
*   Scheduled a public hearing for the proposed 1942 city budget for December 24th.
*   Authorized the Texas Public Service Company to install new gas mains across several city streets, specifying precise locations and minimum depth.
